name: Silithus
summary: Silithus lies beneath spreading silithid swarms, watched by the Cenarion Circle. The desert holds the ancient ruins of Ahn'Qiraj, sealed behind the Scarab Wall a thousand years ago. Druids guard against the swarms and Twilight's Hammer cultists.

sections.title: The Desert Frontier
sections.body: You enter Silithus from Un'Goro Crater through a broad, rocky pass in its northwest corner. Jungle gives way to dunes, jagged stone, and towering hives. Water is scarce, and the wind carries the hum of insect wings across the sand. Near the desert's center, Cenarion Hold offers shelter to travelers, researchers, and warriors. The Cenarion Circle keeps this outpost as the only refuge in the hostile wastes.

sections.title: Echoes of the Shifting Sands
sections.body:
A thousand years ago, night elves and the great dragonflights fought desperately to drive back the Qiraji in the War of the Shifting Sands. The Qiraji were an insectoid empire born from the ancient Aqiri civilization.

When victory proved beyond reach, the defenders sealed the swarms inside their stronghold with the Scarab Wall and enchanted Scarab Dais. The gates held, but silithids burrowed through tunnels below and formed vast colonies across the desert, including Hive'Ashi, Hive'Zora, and Hive'Regal.

sections.title: A Converging Storm
sections.body: Twilight's Hammer has fortified several outposts in Silithus. Its cultists summon elemental terrors and worship the dark power beneath Ahn'Qiraj. Cenarion Circle observers watch the silithid colonies spread and keep guard against the ancient threat behind the Scarab Wall.

faq.q: How do I get to Silithus on foot?
faq.answer: Travel through Un'Goro Crater to its northwestern corner. Near a bend in the serpentine river, a sloping dirt road climbs between two prominent stone pillars and passes through the crater wall into Silithus.

The Scarab Wall is a massive enchanted barrier in southern Silithus. A thousand years ago, night elves and the dragonflights raised it during the War of the Shifting Sands to imprison the Qiraji empire within Ahn'Qiraj.

The Cenarion Circle established and runs Cenarion Hold. Its druids and allied guardians watch the silithid swarms, investigate ancient ruins, and welcome neutral travelers from both the Alliance and Horde.

faq.q: What are the giant insect mounds across the zone?
faq.answer: The giant mounds are the silithids' great underground hives: Hive'Ashi, Hive'Zora, and Hive'Regal. Each holds a sprawling tunnel network and distinct insectoid castes that serve the wills locked behind Ahn'Qiraj.

faq.q: What is the Twilight's Hammer doing here?
aliases: why is twilight's hammer in silithus
faq.answer: Twilight's Hammer maintains several fortified bases in Silithus, including Twilight Base Camp and Twilight Post. Its cultists perform foul rites to summon elementals and worship the ancient, malevolent entities entombed behind the Scarab Wall.

angles.text: As a druid, you are called to Silithus, where the Cenarion Circle keeps its southern Kalimdor operations. Help stem the land's corruption and face the unnatural broods threatening nature's balance.
Silithus's dry rocks and insect tunnels hold some of the world's richest Thorium deposits. Rare ooze-covered veins lie hidden within the silithid hives.
Rare plants flourish despite Silithus's harsh desert: Mountain Silversage, Dreamfoil, Sungrass, and the prized Black Lotus.
As a night elf, you walk the grim ground where your ancestors bled in the War of the Shifting Sands. Thousands sacrificed their lives to seal Ahn'Qiraj's gates.
